other_conditions: Must be a government institution (central university, deemed university, institution of national importance, government‑owned standalone institution, or state university)
Must be among the top 50 in its category on the latest National Ranking Framework, or rank within the top 500 in Times Higher Education, QS, or Shanghai Ranking
Only 10 institutions will be selected as Institutions of Eminence
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹1000 crore in financial assistance and grants extensive autonomy over fees, curriculum, and foreign collaborations.
